seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Weber's designation (California Secretary of State) comes from a single search summary of the certified list. Wagner's designation (Orange County Supervisor) appeared in summaries of both the certified list and the contact list. One summary said the primary certified list showed no designation for Wagner, which is unverified. Garbled PDF extraction placed Herb W Morgan and Jennifer Hawks near the Secretary of State heading. Both are Controller and Treasurer candidates respectively, so these look like artifacts. A Fox 5 San Diego result naming Robert Bernosky as Weber's opponent refers to 2022 and is stale. Wagner's Assembly years were not confirmed. Weber's birth year and birthplace come from the California State Archives (a SoS exhibit), which counts as a government source but is also the incumbent candidate's own office.
